To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed reliability models for four interference theory based models.
the proposed models are useful in reliability analysis of an identical unit system.

(1) the proposed models are more realistic than existing reliability models, because the proposed model takes into account two failure modes of the redundant units; (2) the proposed models have a more accurate reliability function, which is a function of system stress; and (3) the proposed model is more general and can be used in many practical cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing reliability expressions for the four interference theory models for the identical unit parallel system with exponentially distributed failure times.
the development of reliability expressions for four different stress—strength interference theory models.
the development and evaluation of reliability expressions for four stress—strength reliability models of an identical parallel system.
